headline: WBC's cash earnings (net profit excluding Notable Items) decreased by $141 million (-2%) to $6,972 million in FY25 from $7,113 million in FY24. Statutory net profit also fell 1% to $6,916 million. Total operating income grew 3% to $22,464 million, while underlying operating expenses rose 9% to $11,916 million.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 -> Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: NII increased by $557 million (+3%) to $19,473 million, driven by volume growth in average loans and liquid assets, partially offset by margin compression.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 -> Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Other operating income grew by $144 million (+5%) to $2,991 million, supported by higher net fees and trading income.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 -> Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Underlying operating expenses increased by $972 million (+9%) to $11,916 million, primarily due to higher staff and technology costs.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 -> Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Credit impairment charges decreased by $113 million (-21%) to $424 million, providing a positive contribution to earnings as loan loss provisions were lower than the prior year.

drivers.columns: Full Year Sept 2024 -> Full Year Sept 2025
drivers.narrative: Tax expense decreased slightly by $24 million (-1%) to $3,135 million, contributing positively to the bottom line.

notable_items: Hedging items reduced net profit after tax in 2025 by $56 million (2024: $123 million reduction).
limitations: The bridge reconciles the movement in 'Net profit excluding Notable Items' (cash basis). The statutory profit movement differs slightly due to the change in notable items impact.
